briefdescription.para: Replica state machine execution and recovery for federated Process Module.

detaileddescription.para: Implements state machine execution, snapshot management, consistency verification, and automatic recovery from network partitions for multi-node deployments.

simplesect.para: Maturity: 🟡 ALPHA (Phase 2 delivery, production hardening in Phase 5)
This implementation is auto-generated from ROADMAP_FEDERATION.md Phase 2.

listitem.para: Single Writer: Leader applies entries in order; followers replay same sequence
Consistency Verification: Checksums on applied entries; continuous integrity check
Snapshots: Periodic snapshots for O(log N) crash recovery
Recovery: Automatic re-sync from leader via snapshot + tail replication

sect2.title: Snapshot Strategy
sect2.para:
Snapshots are taken periodically to:
Speed up recovery (O(log N) instead of O(N))
Reduce log size on disk
Enable faster follower catch-up during high churn
